program:
app "Quran" book mint
table read juz num 1..30, pages num 1..
setting daily num = 4 "Pages a day"
let done = sum(read.pages)
goal done, 604, "pages read", "pages"
grid 10 gap 1
  each 1..30
    box height 22 radius 4 fill if(it <= max(read.juz), accent, soft)
      it tiny align center
"Today" sum(read.pages today) "of" daily "pages" faint
"At this pace you finish in" round((604 - done) * 30 / sum(read.pages last 30 days)) "days" faint
form read
list read by day
describe:
Quran, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- read: juz: number, 1 to 30; pages: number, at least 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Pages a day": number, starts at 4.
Works out:
- done is the total pages of read.
Shows:
- done out of 604 with a progress bar, labelled "pages read".
- a grid of 10 columns:
  - for each number from 1 to 30:
    - text: the number.
- text: "Today", the total pages of read today, "of", daily, "pages".
- text: "At this pace you finish in", the result of 604 minus done times 30 divided by the total pages of read in the last 30 days rounded, "days".
- a form to add a read.
- a list of read by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with who it is for

app "My Salon" tag plum
table client name text, phone text?
table service name text, price money
table product name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3

screen home "Today" calendar
  stat income, "income this month"

  each visit today as v
    row card
      v.client.name bold grow
      v.service.name
      v.paid

    row card tap edit c swipe remove c
      c.name bold grow
      count(c.visit) "visits" faint

  list service
  form service, "Add service"

  each product sort qty as p
    row card gap 1 tap edit p

      button "-" tap set p.qty = p.qty - 1
      p.qty bold
      button "+" tap set p.qty = p.qty + 1
  form product, "Add product"
screen money "Income" wallet
  stat income, "this month"
  stat sum(visit.paid prev month), "last month"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(visit.paid on it)
  list visit by day

    - text: the qty of the product s.

- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the product s.
